claim: Fastow is Enron CFO and managing member of the general partner of LJM1
Fastow is managing member of the general partner of LJM2, with a performance-dependent profit interest for that general partner
LJM2 borrowed USD38.5m from an Enron affiliate, outstanding at year end
LJM received Enron common shares in a transaction in which Enron received a note and investment-hedging instruments
LJM2 acquired approximately USD360m of merchant assets and investments and Enron recognized approximately USD16m of pretax gains
Proxy says other senior officers negotiated the transactions at arm's length; this statement is a contemporaneous counterconsideration, not verified effective independence
